subject.title: Add an FxTwitter read transport for public lookups, threads, profiles, and search

question: Should Birdclaw extend the current FxTwitter single-tweet import into threads, profiles, timelines, search, and pagination, or keep those operations out of the core transport for now?
rationale: The owner intentionally narrowed the first implementation and explicitly deferred the remaining surfaces, so implementation cannot safely infer the desired provider, privacy, and maintenance commitment.

options.title: Keep the narrow MVP
options.body: Retain only explicit fixed-origin single-tweet import and require a new approved proposal before adding other FxTwitter operations.

options.title: Sponsor a phased read expansion
options.body: Define one bounded next phase, such as thread or profile lookup, with the same fixed-origin and disclosure guarantees.

recommendation.title: Keep the narrow MVP
recommendation.body: Retain only explicit fixed-origin single-tweet import and require a new approved proposal before adding other FxTwitter operations.

likelyOwner.reason: This person set the current provider boundary and landed the initial implementation.
